Lua 5.5.0 license notice
========================

This file reproduces the license notice of the Lua 5.5.0 runtime that is
statically linked into the Linux x86_64 Lua 5.5 prebuilt modules of TDLua.
It is required because those modules contain a substantial portion of the Lua
runtime.

Runtime: Lua 5.5.0
Upstream: https://www.lua.org/
Source archive: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz

Extracted from: doc/readme.html, section "License" (HTML entities resolved;
the wording is unchanged)
